'''Morvrin Thakanos''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Brown Ajah]].{{ref/book|c|Morvrin Thakanos}}

==Appearance==
Morvrin is 5'5" tall, round-faced and stout, with graying hair, brown eyes, plump hands, and ample hips.{{ref/book|5|27}}{{ref/book|5|50}}

Morvrin is a placid sort, and sometimes has an absently vague look. She requires a great deal of proof for anything.

==Strength and Abilities==
Morvrin is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|strong]] in the [[One Power]] for an Aes Sedai. Among the [[Salidar Six]], she is equaled by [[Myrelle Berengari]], [[Carlinya Sorevin]] and [[Anaiya Carel]] with only [[Sheriam Bayanar]] stronger and [[Beonin Marinye]] weaker. However Morvrin serves the distinction of being much more senior, having worn the shawl for more than a hundred and fifty years longer than the others.

She is strong enough to [[Traveling|Travel]].

==History==
Morvrin is 223 years old. She was born in the year {{ne|777}} in Illian and went to the Tower in {{ne|795}}. After spending seven years as novice and six as Accepted she was raised to the shawl in the year {{ne|808}}.

She has a single [[Warder]], [[Jori]].

She says she believes in common sense more than logic, though she more often blends the two. She is hard-headed and suspicious of easy answers.{{ref/book|10|16}}

==Activities==
=== Into [[Salidar]] ===
She was one of the original leaders of the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]], known informally to fans as the [[Salidar Six]]. While searching the Amyrlin's study in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'' for information on what [[Elaida do Avriny a'Roihan|Elaida]] had received, the Salidar Six were attacked by a stray nightmare of [[Trolloc]]s. They were saved when [[Elayne Trakand]] and [[Siuan Sanche]] had to remind them about the dream not being real, at which point the nightmare faded away.{{ref/book|6|7}}

She was with the rest of the Salidar Six in ''Tel'aran'rhiod'' when they summoned [[Egwene al'Vere]] to become Amyrlin.

When Egwene was brought before the [[Rebel Hall of the Tower]] as a candidate for Amyrlin, Morvrin, [[Myrelle Berengari]], and [[Sheriam Bayanar]] are the three sisters that enter the Hall as her necessary representatives.

She swore an oath of fealty to Egwene and became a member of [[Egwene's Council]]. She was with Egwene and [[Gareth Bryne]] when they surveyed the area around Tar Valon.{{ref/book|10|16}}

=== Egwene captive ===
She was in council with Egwene's other advisors over Egwene's disappearance when Siuan arrived with the news that Egwene was still alive but prisoner inside the White Tower.{{ref/book|11|p}} She woke [[Beonin Marinye]] with this news.

When the [[Black Ajah]] attacked Egwene and other female channelers following a meeting ''Tel'aran'riod'', Morvrin was there. She was one of the Aes Sedai who Egwene invited to flee before the [[Battle in Tel'aran'rhiod]] started.{{ref/book|14|37}}
